claims: ChatGPT is an artificial intelligence (AI) model.
Prompts are natural language instructions or data designed to elicit a specific output in AI.
Types of prompts include instructional prompts, contextual prompts, and persona-based prompts.
The word "prompt" originates from Latin "promptus" ("brought forth").
The word "prompt" has been in use since the 15th century.
The meaning of the word "prompt" has expanded to represent a "cue" or "command".
Role-playing/Persona prompts instruct the AI to act in a specific role.
Few-shot prompts provide examples to the AI model before asking it to perform a task.
Zero-shot prompts ask the AI model to complete a task without any examples.
